COMPUTER SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING
Campus Placement Highlights
Welcome
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the LBRCE was established in 1998, offers Undergraduate Programs - B.Tech in CSE and Post Graduate Program - M.Tech in Data Science . The B.Tech (Computer Science and Engineering) program was started in the year 1998 with an intake of 40 students and the intake was subsequently increased to 60 students in the year 1999, 90 students in the year 2008, 120 students in the year 2009, 180 students in the year 2019, 240 students in the year 2023, 420 students in the year 2024, 480 students in the year 2025 and 300 students in the year 2026 . The M.Tech. in Data Science program was introduced in the academic year 2023–24 with an approved intake of 06 students. From the academic year 2026–27 onwards, the institute has also started the M.Tech. in Cyber Security program with an approved intake of 06 students. Currently, the institute is equipped with a high-speed Internet connection of 2090 Mbps , providing seamless connectivity to support academic, research, and administrative activities.
VISION
The Computer Science & Engineering aims at providing continuously stimulating educational environment to its students for attaining their professional goals and meet the global challenges.
MISSION
To develop a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science discipline with an emphasis on problem solving.

Welcome
The Department has various R&D groups, like Communication Systems & Signal Processing, VLSI and Embedded Systems, Cognitive science and MEMS. They attended and presented quality papers in international and National conferences and published good number of papers in various reputed international and National journals. In R&D, we got 4 DST projects worth Rs. 1 Crore 25 Lakhs and one AICTE sponsored workshop worth Rs.2 Lakhs . AICTE has sanctioned Rs.10 Lakhs for the modernization of DSP/ECAD/EC Simulation Lab under MODROBS scheme in the year 2010 and Rs.9.37 Lakhs for the modernization of ECAD Lab (VLSI/ Embedded Systems) in the Academic year 2018-19.
VISION
To produce quality engineers in the field of Electronics & Communication Engineering to face the global technical challenges.
MISSION
